system.description:
Designed for expeditions into sealed tombs, the faceplate, neck and joints can be closed with leather gaskets and waxed cloth. You gain a +1-item bonus to Fortitude saves against disease and poison transmitted by contact or inhalation. The armour provides no protection against magical effects merely because they originate within a tomb.

On the sheet: +1 item is pre-ticked on Fortitude saves against Disease and Poison effects while the plate is worn; the Helm's −1 to Perception applies as the core rule.

Pillars of Faith, Chapter 6.
